As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Staff Demo Engineer on the Demo Engineering team, you’ll shape the technical tooling and platform behind 1Password’s go-to-market demo experience. You’ll build scalable demo environments, interactive product experiences, and shared infrastructure that help teams communicate 1Password’s value across the customer journey. Your work will help make secure access simpler and support 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future for everyone.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

  • Bring substantial experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, technical marketing, DevOps, solutions architecture, or demo engineering.

  • Apply experience in cybersecurity, identity, Privileged Access Management (PAM), developer tools, or a related technical domain.

  • Build full-stack and automation solutions using technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, React, or Python, with experience designing systems that other engineers can build on.

  • Design and operate infrastructure using infrastructure as code, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), containers, and cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Understand identity and access management concepts, including single sign-on (SSO), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OpenID Connect (OIDC), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), device trust, passwordless authentication, and passkeys.

  • Balance speed, reliability, cost, and security while explaining technical tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical partners.

  • Create interactive software-as-a-service (SaaS) demos and guided product experiences using platforms such as Reprise, Navattic, Walnut, or Arcade; experience with mobile device management (MDM) tools such as Jamf, live event demos, utilization analysis, artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted tooling, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers is also valuable.

What you can expect:

  • Set the technical vision, roadmap, and long-term architecture for 1Password’s demo platform.

  • Lead the design of shared demo infrastructure, including templates, automated provisioning and resets, data generation, and observability.

  • Build sample applications and integrations across 1Password products to support demos and enablement programs.

  • Support complex, high-visibility demos for flagship launches, keynotes, conferences, and strategic customer opportunities.

  • Drive AI-assisted tooling that automates demo preparation, validation, and maintenance.

  • Partner with Engineering Security on demo environments and lead architecture and code reviews.

  • Mentor Demo Engineers and Senior Demo Engineers while representing Demo Engineering in cross-functional technical decisions and product roadmap discussions.

  • Travel quarterly, including cross-border travel, for conferences and company offsites.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $135,000 USD and $196,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $129,000 CAD and $187,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

You belong here.

data.description:
Why RTI

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

Client Technology Operations (CTO) is RTI's client-focused technology organization responsible for delivering and operating the technology platforms, infrastructure, governance, engineering, and digital capabilities that enable RTI to develop, secure, and deliver technology-enabled solutions for clients.

This role supports enterprise infrastructure monitoring and data protection across on-premises and cloud environments. You will work with technologies such as SolarWinds and Cohesity to monitor system health and performance, support backup and recovery operations, troubleshoot technical issues, and identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. This position offers the opportunity to build technical expertise across infrastructure monitoring, systems administration, and data protection while contributing to the reliability and availability of RTI's IT systems.

This position offers flexible work arrangements, including remote work within the U.S., hybrid, or on-site in our Research Triangle Park, NC headquarters location. Some geographic locations may not be available for remote work based on business and operational requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of the SolarWinds Platform (NPM, SAM, NTA, NCM) and Cohesity Data Platform (Cohesity Helios).

  • Configure and monitor daily backup policies protecting on-premises assets (VMware, physical servers) and cloud workloads (AWS, Azure) using Cohesity.

  • Customize SolarWinds alerting thresholds, maintain dashboards, and support integration of alerts with ticketing platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira) to maintain high environment visibility.

  • Leverage PowerShell, Python, or Bash to automate routine monitoring, backup checks, and system administration tasks.

  • Troubleshoot infrastructure alerts, resolve backup failures, and perform routine data restoration requests to verify system integrity.

  • Maintain network configuration backups (via SolarWinds NCM), update standard operating procedures, and support compliance reporting activities.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of SOPs, system standards, business continuity plans, system test plans, and capacity plans.

  • Research technical solutions and contribute to evaluations and recommendations, including pros/cons and pricing, as needed.

  • Support the installation and configuration of hardware or software in accordance with manufacturer's recommendations and technical specifications.

  • Conduct quality assurance testing to validate installed configurations and operations against technical specifications, documenting results and identifying issues as needed.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve problems in response to alerts from monitoring tools or trouble reports from other ITS staff, escalating issues as appropriate.

  • Communicate status to impacted stakeholders, including end users, ITS support staff, and ITS management, before, during, and after installation or problem resolution, as appropriate and in accordance with SOPs.

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field and at least one year of relevant experience supporting IT infrastructure, systems administration, infrastructure monitoring, backup/recovery, or a related technical area.

  • Experience supporting and troubleshooting IT infrastructure, including servers, virtual environments, storage, networked systems, or cloud-based technologies.

  • Experience using at least one scripting language, such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash, for automation, system administration, or troubleshooting.

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure monitoring concepts, including system health, performance monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting.

  • Working knowledge of data protection concepts, including backups, restores, recovery, system availability, and business continuity.

  • Experience investigating technical issues, identifying potential causes, and implementing or recommending solutions, with guidance or escalation as appropriate.

  • Experience developing or maintaining technical documentation, including system configurations, troubleshooting procedures, or standard operating procedures.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage assigned tasks, prioritize competing responsibilities, and work both independently and collaboratively within a technical team.

  • To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status, etc.). 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SolarWinds or another enterprise infrastructure monitoring platform.

  • Experience with Cohesity or another enterprise backup and recovery platform.

  • Experience supporting VMware or other virtualization environments.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or other cloud infrastructure environments.

  • Experience using APIs or scripting to automate monitoring, backup, reporting, or system administration activities.

  • Familiarity with IT service management or ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow or Jira.

  • Familiarity with network monitoring, system configuration management, or backup technologies.

  • Experience supporting technical documentation, compliance reporting, system testing, or disaster recovery exercises.

EEO & Pay Equity Statements

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

RTI considers multiple factors when making an offer including, for example: established salary range, internal budget, business needs, and education and years of work experience possessed by the applicant. Further, salary is merely one element to our offer.

At RTI, we demonstrate our commitment to rewarding individual and team achievement through a total rewards package. This package includes (among other things) a competitive base salary, a generous paid time off policy, merit based annual increases, bonus opportunities and a robust recognition program. data.description:
We are looking for a talented Network Engineer to join our growing global team at Sectigo.

The Network Engineer is responsible for supporting, implementing, managing, and maintaining the organization's networking infrastructure. This individual is detail-oriented, thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and possesses a proven track record in learning, implementing, and maintaining enterprise networks and new technologies. Must be a commutable distance to Manchester DC, should the need arise.

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

  • Network: Designing, planning, and implementing network infrastructure move, add, or changes. Including maintenance and support.

  • Network Security: Implementing and maintaining network security protocols, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), VPNs, access control lists (ACLs), and encryption technologies to safeguard the organization's data and systems.

  • Network Troubleshooting and Optimization: Diagnosing and resolving complex network issues, analyzing network performance, and optimizing network infrastructure to ensure high availability, reliability, and performance.

  • Documentation and Reporting: Creating and maintaining network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Generating reports on network performance, security incidents, and compliance status for management review.

  • Capacity Planning: Assessing current and future network capacity requirements based on business growth projections and technology trends. Planning and implementing scalability solutions to accommodate increasing demand.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring network infrastructure compliance with industry regulations, standards, and best practices (e.g., PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO, Webtrust). Conducting audits and implementing remediation measures as needed.

  • Mounting and Installation: Ability to mount and install network devices such as routers, switches, and servers in data centers and office locations. This includes rack mounting, cable management, and hardware configuration. Candidates must be able to lift network equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.

  • Travel & Operational Requirements:

    • Participate in on-call rotation.
    • Travel both internationally and nationally as needed (site support meetings, projects, etc.).
    • Frequent visits to Datacenter near Manchester.

  • Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

More information about this role:

  • This is a full-time and remote position based in U.K., with the ideal candidate reside within 1-hour driving distance to the greater Manchester area.
  • The targeted compensation package for this role is between GBP 55,000 and 62,000 per annum, subject upon internal equity and years of experience. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field is strongly preferred. Relevant certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, CISSP) are a plus.

Experience:

  • Proven experience (typically 5+ years) in network engineering roles, with a focus on supporting, implementing, and managing enterprise-scale network infrastructures.

  • Automation and Infrastructure as Code (IAC):

    • Ability to create, implement, and maintain automation using Terraform and Ansible.
    • Proficiency with GIT.
    • Comfortable with JSON, YAML, and XML.
    • Knowledge of Python is a plus.

  • Cloud Environments:

    • AWS network experience is necessary (TGWs, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, Security Groups, VPCs, Subnet,etc..), and general experience is required.

  • Must be proficient in installing, implementing, supporting, and maintaining Juniper, Palo Alto, and Arista hardware and software for Datacenter and Campus environments.

  • Knowledge of SD-WAN technologies such as Palo Alto, Aruba/Silverpeak, or Cisco/Viptela is a plus.

  • Site to Site VPN: Must be able to design, implement, and support Route based and Policy based VPN. Knowledge of specific technologies such as DMVPN, FlexVPN, and other vendor-specific VPNs is a plus.

  • RA VPN: Must be able to design, implement, and support enterprise VPNs such as Global Protect or AnyConnect.

  • VXLAN: Understanding of overlay vs underlay and how it interacts with EVPN

  • AAA: Must be able to support, implement, and maintain Radius and Tacacs+ for both device access management and NAC (e.g., 802.1x). SAML-based authentication is a plus.

  • Network Monitoring: Must be able to implement, support, and use: Netflow, SNMP, and related enterprise tools (e.g., Solarwinds, Nagios, LiveNX).

  • FW Technologies and Traffic Flow: Must understand stateful vs non-stateful rules, symmetric vs non-symmetric, NAT types, order of operation, etc.

  • L3 Routing Protocols: Must have knowledge of OSPFv2, OSPFv3 and BGP. Knowledge of others such as ISIS and mBGP is a plus.

  • L3: Must know IPv6. IPv4 and IPv6 dual stack is a plus.

  • Layer 2: Must understand rSTP, dot1q, vlan, L2 security

  • Wireless: Good understanding wireless, roaming, troubleshooting

  • HA: Must understand FHRP (VRRP, HSRP, etc.), LACP, BFD, switch stacks.etc.

  • TCP/IP: Must understand path MTU discovery (ICMP), basic TCP flags, etc.

  • DNS, DHCP, ARP, Neighbor Discovery: Must have a good understanding.

  • Segment Packet Frame troubleshooting: Must be comfortable packet captures and utilizing tools like Wireshark and tcpdump.

Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:

  • In-depth knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, VLANs, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, etc.
  • Strong understanding of network security principles and best practices, including firewall configuration, intrusion detection/prevention, encryption, and secure remote access.
  • Proficiency in network hardware and software, such as Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Aruba, etc. Experience with SDN, SD-WAN, and cloud networking is desirable.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, and mentor junior staff.
  • Attention to detail, organization, and documentation skills, with a commitment to maintaining accurate network documentation and following standard procedures.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies, methodologies, and tools to keep pace with evolving business needs and industry trends.

About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

The Cloud DX team owns the outer loop of software development at AlphaSense, everything from the moment code is pushed to source control to the moment it reaches production, for ~400 engineers distributed across the globe. We've built a solid delivery foundation and we're now raising the bar toward industry-leading CI/CD. Progressive delivery, canary deployments, automated rollbacks, trunk-based development, GitOps workflows: these aren't aspirations but the direction we're actively building, and we're looking for passionate engineers to help shape what best-in-class looks like.

About the Role:

This is a Staff Engineer role with real breadth. It requires both operational and software development skills, the ability to lead projects and collaborate across timezones with Engineering leaders and very senior Engineers across dozens of teams. You'll design and operate production-grade delivery infrastructure, contribute hands-on in Go and Python, and help shape the engineering practices a global organisation depends on.
We're looking for someone who genuinely embraces AI tooling in their day-to-day work, appreciates the productivity value it brings, and is motivated to push that further, both in their own practice and by helping embed AI-assisted workflows into the SDLC for the wider engineering organization.

Who You Are:

  • Strong experience in Platform Engineering or Developer Experience roles focused on CI/CD and delivery, ideally at companies with 200+ engineers

  • Experience owning and operating a CI/CD platform at admin and architecture level, including security, configuration, and enablement

  • Proven ability to design and operate delivery systems at scale

  • Hands-on software development experience including production-quality Go

  • Passion for progressive delivery practices: canary deployments & automated rollbacks

  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and Kubernetes-based platforms

  • Passion for using AI to improve engineering velocity, quality, and developer experience

  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to influence across teams

  • [Nice to Have] Built and/or maintained an IDP in production

  • [Nice to Have] Previous experience working in both Software and Platform Engineering teams

  • [Nice to Have] Interest in Security and an understanding of RBAC and OAuth

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and evolve our CI/CD architecture and the developer-facing experience

  • Drive continuous improvements to pipeline reliability, speed, and predictability

  • Define paved paths that let product teams ship fast and safely without deep platform knowledge

  • Own the delivery process end-to-end, from code merge to production

  • Champion progressive delivery practices: canary deployments & automated rollbacks

  • Build tooling that makes deployments observable, repeatable, and self-service

  • Own and evolve our Internal Developer Portal and the self-service experience around it

  • Partner with Cloud Platform teams on infrastructure while owning the developer-facing delivery

  • Embed AI tooling into delivery workflows in ways that create lasting productivity gains.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

data.description:
Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines.  Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

About the Role

 We're seeking an experienced Platform Engineer to own and evolve our AWS infrastructure. You'll design, build, and maintain the systems that enable our engineering teams to ship reliably. This is a hands-on role where you'll work across Kubernetes orchestration, infrastructure-as-code practices, cloud networking, and identity management. You'll balance strategic infrastructure improvements with operational excellence.

What we're looking for

You're someone who understands that infrastructure is a product for your internal users. You think holistically about reliability, security, and developer experience. You communicate technical concepts clearly to both engineers and leadership. You're comfortable making trade-offs between perfection and pragmatism, and you own the systems you build. You're curious about how things work under the hood and stay current with infrastructure trends.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS with a focus on reliability, security, and cost efficiency
  • Develop infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools; maintain version control and CI/CD integration for all infrastructure changes
  • Architect and implement AWS networking solutions including VPCs, security groups, load balancing, and service mesh technologies
  • Design and implement identity and access management (IAM) strategies, including RBAC, service accounts, and cross-account access patterns
  • Establish observability and monitoring across infrastructure, troubleshoot production issues, and drive continuous improvement
  • Partner with development teams to enable self-service capabilities and reduce operational friction
  • Document architectural decisions and maintain runbooks for critical infrastructure

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with infrastructure engineering or equivalent platform engineering experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes (production deployments, resource management, troubleshooting)
  • Demonstrated expertise in infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of AWS services, particularly EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, VPC, and related networking components
  • Deep knowledge of IAM principles and hands-on experience implementing least-privilege access controls
  • Experience with networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, service mesh concepts)
  • Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (Go, Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Experience managing containers and container orchestration in production environments
  • Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to handle on-call escalations
  • Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd)
  • Familiarity with GitOps workflows and tools (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog, New Relic)
  • Knowledge of security best practices for Kubernetes and AWS (pod security policies, network policies, SIEM integration)
  • Demonstrated comfort using Claude.ai or similar AI tools to enhance productivity and accelerate problem-solving
  • Experience with cost optimization and capacity planning in AWS
  • Involvement in on-call rotations and incident response experience

What you'll work with:

  • AWS services: EKS, EC2, RDS, S3, VPC, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudWatch
  • Infrastructure tools: Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm
  • Observability: CloudWatch, or similar monitoring/logging platforms
  • Collaboration tools: Git, CI/CD platforms, issue tracking systems

About our culture

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

data.title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote • Canada

About Upsun

Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

  • Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.
  • Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:
    • Predictable performance, even at scale
    • Secure, compliant environments by default
    • Real-time observability and profiling built in
    • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
    • Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. 

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

We make a positive impact.

We aim for the stars.

We care for each other. 

Impact of a Senior IT Systems Engineer

As a Senior IT Engineer, you help shape and improve the systems that our 250+ person remote company relies on every day. Your work spans identity and access, Google Workspace, device management, and our wider SaaS environment.
Reporting to the IT Director, you take ownership of complex problems and lead improvements from initial assessment through delivery. You identify what needs attention, recommend priorities, and make thoughtful decisions that balance security, reliability, and employee experience. You also help the team build stronger practices through clear documentation, shared knowledge, and practical guidance.

What to expect

  • Identity platform: Improve our identity and access services, with Okta at the core. This includes single sign-on, automated account provisioning, multi-factor authentication, access policies, and emergency access. Work with IT and Security to make access secure, consistent, and straightforward.

  • Google Workspace: Lead the administration and improvement of our Google Workspace environment, including users, groups, Gmail, Drive, shared drives, and security settings. Improve how people collaborate, manage sharing and access, and keep our configuration aligned with business needs.

  • Device management: Help lead the rollout and ongoing development of JumpCloud and our device management practices across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Define and implement device configurations, security policies, software deployment, and onboarding processes in partnership with IT Operations and Security.

  • Automation and employee lifecycle: Design and improve onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across identity, devices, and SaaS tools. Use tools such as Okta Workflows, n8n, Python, and APIs to reduce manual work and make processes more reliable.

  • Continuous improvement: Assess our current systems, identify gaps, and turn findings into practical improvements. Investigate complex issues across connected services, address root causes, and follow through until changes are working well.

  • SaaS administration and governance: Administer our core internal tools and help evaluate new applications. Establish clear practices for application setup, integrations, access requests, approvals, and access reviews.

  • Security and compliance: Partner with Security and the Risk and Audit team to implement and maintain controls across identity, Google Workspace, devices, and SaaS tools. Automate evidence collection where practical to support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2.

  • Project delivery and mentoring: Lead projects from scoping and technical design through rollout and handover. Coordinate dependencies, communicate risks and progress, and help colleagues grow through documentation, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

What you bring

  • Broad IT engineering experience: You have hands-on experience across identity, collaboration tools, endpoint management, and SaaS administration. You understand how these systems connect and can troubleshoot problems across them.

  • Depth in a core area: You bring strong expertise in at least one of Okta, Google Workspace, or JumpCloud, along with the ability to work across the others. We welcome different strengths; you do not need to be equally expert in all three.

  • Device management deployment: You have helped deploy or significantly improve an MDM or endpoint management platform. You can turn security and operational requirements into workable configurations, test them, and roll them out with minimal disruption.

  • Automation and scripting: You build reliable automation using workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and Python or a comparable scripting language. You consider error handling, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

  • A track record of improvement: You can share examples of systems or processes you assessed, improved, and delivered, with clear results for employees or the IT team.

  • Proactive judgment and ownership: You work independently, make sound technical decisions, and know when to involve others. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, explain trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome.

  • Security and compliance awareness: You have implemented controls such as access reviews, secure configurations, or device policies, and understand how to document and demonstrate that they work. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 is valuable.

  • Clear communication and collaboration: You work effectively in a fully remote team and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues across cultures. You share knowledge and help others become more effective.

  • Experience: Typically six or more years in IT engineering, systems administration, identity, or endpoint management, with increasing responsibility for technical decisions and project delivery. Equivalent experience matters more than a specific number of years.

Bonus points

  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including assessing and integrating identity systems, Google Workspace environments, devices, or SaaS tools.

  • Experience in a developer-heavy or engineering-led company.

  • Experience supporting both ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2, including automated evidence collection.

  • Professional proficiency in French.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans more than 30 countries and a wide range of experience levels, and we’re currently hiring for this role in Canada. We’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, but we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire

Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving.

We know a great hire won’t meet every requirement above. If you can see yourself making the team better, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here if someone hadn’t taken a chance on us.

You can expect 4 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, IT)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (Senior Director, Site Reliability Engineering, Senior IT Manager)
  4. 45 Minutes with Executive (Senior Director, FP&A & IT)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

Flexible PTO

Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain)

Company stock options

Professional development budget

Office equipment budget

‍️ Wellness budget

Annual team gatherings

Inclusive parental leave

️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upsun-senior-it-systems-engineer

data.description:
About Zuma

Zuma is pioneering the future of agentic AI and our focus is to transform the rental market experience for consumers and property manager alike. Our innovative platform is engineered from the ground up to boost operations efficiency and enhance support capabilities for property management business across the US and Canada, a ~$200B market.

Off the back of our Series-A in early 2024, Zuma is scaling rapidly. Achieving our vision requires a team of passionate, innovative individuals eager to leverage technology to redefine customer-business interactions. We're on the hunt for exceptional talent ready to join our mission and contribute to building a groundbreaking technology that reshapes how businesses engage with customers.

Zuma has raised over $17M in funding to date and has support from world-renowned investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Y Combinator, King River, Range Ventures, and distinguished angel investors like YC’s former COO, Qasar Younis.

The Role

As a Support Engineer at Zuma, you’ll be a bridge between our customers, engineering team, and product vision. You’ll ensure new customers onboard smoothly, integrations run reliably, and support operations scale as we grow. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves problem-solving, can dive into APIs and databases, and takes pride in clear documentation and communication. You’ll help property managers succeed with our AI platform while also driving continuous improvements in our internal tools and processes.

Why This Could Be Your Dream Role

  • You want to work at a company where customers feel your impact every day
  • You'll have autonomy to design and implement innovative technical solutions
  • Your work will directly impact thousands of apartment communities and millions of renters
  • You'll receive significant equity in a venture-backed company with strong traction
  • As we scale, your role and influence will grow with the company

Why You Might Want to Think Twice

  • This is a demanding role that will often require extended hours and deep commitment
  • As a founding team member, you'll need to wear multiple hats and step outside your comfort zone
  • You'll need to make thoughtful tradeoffs between innovation and immediate needs
  • You'll interact directly with customers to understand their needs and occasionally travel to their offices
  • We're a startup - priorities can shift rapidly as we respond to market opportunities and customer needs
  • If you're not comfortable getting your hands dirty with legacy code or speaking directly with customers, this isn't the job for you

Responsibilities

  • Lead critical system rewrites to transform our architecture into a highly scalable, resilient foundation
  • Own the design and performance optimization of our data storage systems, ensuring they scale with customer and AI demands
  • Build and evolve our deployment pipelines, enabling reliable, automated releases for AI-first products
  • Set up and manage modern cloud infrastructure from scratch, leveraging Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to ensure consistency, security, and scalability
  • Establish engineering best practices, including observability, incident response processes, and system hardening for an AI-first platform
  • Drive robust analytics and monitoring to track performance, reliability, and the effectiveness of our AI solutions
  • Mentor engineers and elevate the team's capabilities across infrastructure, scalability, and AI product development

Your Experience Looks Like

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 3+ years of experience building production-grade software systems, with a focus on scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Proven expertise in backend development with , including API design, system architecture, and cloud-based services
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar) and deploying production systems using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi)
  • Hands-on experience with database design, performance tuning, and scaling high-throughput data systems
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern DevOps practices
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a distributed, fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable operating in early-stage, high-ownership environments with evolving requirements
  • Bonus: Experience with React and TypeScript on the frontend, though this role leans backend/infrastructure
  • Bonus: Exposure to LLM-based systems, AI infrastructure, or agentic AI workflows

Guiding Principles

    Customer‑First Outcomes

    Every commit should trace back to resident or operator value. Whether it’s a new feature, infra investment, or AI capability, if it doesn’t solve a real problem, it doesn’t ship.

    Bias for Simplicity

    We favor composable primitives over clever abstractions. Open standards, clean APIs, and clear contracts win over custom complexity, even if the custom version is cooler.

    Quality Is a Gate, Not an After‑Thought

    Quality is built-in from day one. Our definition of done includes: test coverage, performance checks, basic observability, and internal docs. Shipping fast doesn’t mean skipping craftsmanship.

    Data‑Driven Choices

    We use data to guide, not paralyze, our decision-making. We track leading indicators (cycle time, defect rate, NPS) and lagging signals (retention, revenue impact). We keep instrumentation lightweight but meaningful signal over spreadsheet.

    Transparency & Written Culture

    Good ideas don’t expire in Zoom. We operate in public inside the company, TDDs, PR reviews, and Linear tickets tell the story. This keeps us async-friendly, auditable, and aligned across time zones and functions.

Other Benefits

  • Great health insurance, dental, and vision.
  • Gym and workspace stipends.
  • Computer and workspace enhancements.
  • Unlimited PTO.
  • Opportunity to play a critical role in building the foundations of the company and Engineering culture.

data.description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com
URL: https://ignitionit.com

Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first 

TL;DR

ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.

We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.

What the actual job???

Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”

You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.

  • Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.

  • Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.

  • Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.

  • Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."

⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.

About ignitionit.com

We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!

What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.

We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.

If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance.

The tech you'll work with (and grow into)

Day one, you'll be living in:

  • Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more)

  • Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows

  • Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles

  • Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends)

  • Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client

  • The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling

⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open.

Who we hope you are

The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you:

  • Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both)

  • Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband

  • Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem

  • Have at least 5 years of IT support experience on the job. 

⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who:

  • Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people

  • Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time

  • Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it

  • Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line

  • Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former

  • Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine)

  • Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application)

  • Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously

Regarding AI

Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive.

Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you.

Compensation & logistics

  • Base salary: Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. 

  • Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones.

  • Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet.

How to apply

The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how:

  1. Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works.

  2. If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items.

  3. From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment.

If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different?

Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-msp-mac-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Our client is a global insights and strategy consultancy operating at the intersection of content, culture, and technology. The company partners with leading organizations across entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming, delivering research, data-driven insights, and strategic guidance to help businesses understand audiences, navigate market trends, and make informed decisions. As part of a global marketing and communications group, the company operates internationally, with offices in major cities including Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, London, and Singapore.


Job Summary

We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our client's core infrastructure and full-stack platform engineering team, helping build, maintain, and improve the cloud platform that powers its data and software products. The role focuses on managing Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure using Terraform, enhancing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and secure OIDC authentication, and ensuring reliable, secure, and repeatable deployment workflows. The ideal candidate will be comfortable troubleshooting infrastructure and pipeline issues independently, identifying root causes, improving operational processes, and documenting technical solutions. Working closely with senior engineers, the engineer will gradually take ownership of production release support while developing the technical expertise and autonomy needed to grow into senior-level responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines, primarily using GitHub Actions and OIDC-based keyless cloud authentication.

  • Use logs, tests, metrics, and other technical evidence to investigate issues and guide decisions.

  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve planning, code reviews, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.

  • Gradually take greater ownership of infrastructure improvements, production support, and technical decision-making.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or platform engineering.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

  • Experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitHub Actions.

  • Experience working with at least one major cloud provider, with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) strongly preferred.

  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, including VPCs, DNS, and firewalls.

  • Knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM), secrets management, and secure cloud authentication practices.

  • Scripting experience with Python or Bash.

  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills.

  • Ability to investigate technical issues independently, communicate blockers clearly, and document findings and solutions.

  • Good written English and sufficient spoken English to collaborate effectively with a US-based team.

  • Availability to work standard US-timezone business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with GCP and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).

  • Experience implementing GitHub Actions workflows and OIDC-based keyless authentication.

  • Experience supporting production releases, responding to DevOps incidents, and resolving operational issues.

  • Experience reviewing infrastructure changes and documenting technical decisions, runbooks, and handoffs.

  • Ability to work independently in ambiguous situations, assess risks, and propose evidence-based improvements.

  • Familiarity with GCP services such as Cloud SQL, Cloud DNS, Cloud Monitoring and Logging, and Secret Manager.

  • Familiarity with Redis and cloud-based data infrastructure.

    Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools for planning, code reviews, troubleshooting, and documentation.

What We Offer

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

data.description:
OnTrac is hiring a Senior Enterprise Architect!

Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and excel at problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter!

Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same-day and next-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e-commerce and product-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S.

Location:

REMOTE: This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals.

Compensation:

The expected starting base pay range for this position is $180,000 - $225,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $180,000 - $270,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan of up to a 25% Bonus Target.

Employment Logistics:

Reporting to the CTO, this position is a hands-on, highly technical architect responsible for designing and building the AI-native platform, data, and integration architecture that powers OnTrac’s last mile delivery network. Working across platform, core, and domain engineering teams, this position defines the target-state architecture on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for generative AI, agentic workflows, and real-time data, proves designs through proofs of concept and reference implementations, and partners with engineers to take them into production. The role brings deep expertise in LLM frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), multi-agent systems, data engineering, API management, architecture patterns, and DevOps and LLMOps, and keeps the organization at the forefront of rapidly evolving AI technology.

Unpacking the Benefits:

Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and short- and long-term disability coverage
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
  • Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure-based increases up to 160 hours
  • Two (2) floating holidays per year
  • Paid sick leave*
  • Six (6) paid company holidays
  • Two (2) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4) weeks paid parental bonding leave
  • Additional wellness and employee assistance programs

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies.

The Must-Haves:

This position requires a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and 10 years of relevant experience in software engineering, data engineering, or solution architecture, including at least 7 years in an architecture role and 2 years of hands-on generative AI or LLM solution delivery. MUST HAVE 3 years of hands-on experience designing, building, and running production solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). MUST HAVE 3 years of experience in the last mile delivery, parcel, or logistics industry, supporting technology for delivery operations such as route planning, sortation, scanning, tracking, or driver and dispatch systems. MUST HAVE experience designing and implementing enterprise API management and integration platforms, such as Apigee, MuleSoft, Kong, or Azure API Management.

Success in this role requires:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, including agent frameworks (such as Google ADK, LangGraph, or CrewAI), multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, agent memory, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols.
  • Expert knowledge of GCP architecture and its AI and data services, such as Vertex AI, Gemini, Vertex AI Vector Search, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, GKE, Cloud Run, and Apigee.
  • Expert knowledge of data engineering for AI, including data modeling, batch and stream processing, ETL/ELT, change data capture (CDC), lakehouse design, feature and vector stores, data quality, and data governance.
  • Strong knowledge of API management and integration, including API design standards, gateways, OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, event streaming with Kafka and Pub/Sub, and exposing APIs as tools for AI agents.
  • Strong DevOps, MLOps, and LLMOps skills, including Terraform, CI/CD tooling (such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Cloud Build), Kubernetes, model and prompt versioning, automated evaluation, and LLM observability tools.
  • Understanding of last mile delivery and parcel logistics, including the parcel lifecycle, scan events, network planning, routing, geospatial data, and driver and carrier operations, and where AI creates value in each.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, balance hands-on engineering with architectural leadership, and prioritize multiple initiatives.

Google Cloud Professional certifications, such as Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or Professional Data Engineer and experience establishing an AI center of excellence, agent platform, or reference architectures and standards in a product-led technology organization are strongly preferred.

Your Mission in Motion:

A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives.

  • Define and own the target-state architecture for OnTrac’s AI-native logistics platform on GCP, spanning shared platform services, reusable core services, domain applications, and the AI and agent layer that runs across them.
  • Design and build agentic and multi-agent systems, including agent orchestration, planning and tool use, memory and state management, human-in-the-loop controls, and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.
  • Architect the MCP server ecosystem that exposes core logistics services (orders, shipments, tracking, locations, routing) and enterprise data as governed, reusable tools for internal and external AI agents.
  • Design AI-ready data platforms, including batch and real-time streaming pipelines, lakehouse and warehouse architectures, feature stores, and vector stores, using services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Spanner, AlloyDB, and Vertex AI Vector Search.
  • Define a canonical, unified data model and event taxonomy for orders, shipments, scan events, locations, containers, and drivers, published as versioned contracts and as semantic context for LLMs and agents, with data quality, lineage, and governance built in.
  • Define the API and integration architecture, including API-first design, REST, gRPC, and asynchronous APIs, OpenAPI and AsyncAPI contracts, API management through Apigee, and event-driven integration over Pub/Sub and Kafka, serving applications and AI agents alike.
  • Apply and document architecture patterns for distributed and AI systems, including microservices, domain-driven design, event sourcing, CQRS, and saga, alongside agentic patterns such as ReAct, planner-executor, supervisor and router agents, and advanced RAG, and publish reference architectures for engineering teams.
  • Build proofs of concept, prototypes, and reference implementations hands-on to validate new models, agent frameworks, and AI tools, de-risk designs, and move quickly from experiment to production; write production-quality code alongside engineering teams.
  • Apply AI to last mile delivery capabilities, including intelligent order intake, address validation and geocoding, route optimization, delivery promise and ETA prediction, exception management, AI-powered control tower operations, driver and dispatch assistance, and conversational customer experiences.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, author architecture decision records (ADRs), contribute to architecture governance and AI technology selection, and mentor engineers across teams.

Paving your way to your success:

  • You are a hands-on, highly technical architect responsible for designing and building the AI-native platform, data, and integration architecture that powers OnTrac’s last mile delivery network.
  • You work across platform, core, and domain engineering teams, defining the target-state architecture on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for generative AI, agentic workflows, and real-time data, proving designs through proofs of concept and reference implementations, and partner with engineers to take them into production.
  • You bring deep expertise in LLM frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), multi-agent systems, data engineering, API management, architecture patterns, and DevOps and LLMOps, and keep the organization at the forefront of rapidly evolving AI technology.

Disclosures:

  • *Washington state employees are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid sick leave annually.
  • The salary range above represents the national range for this position. The salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at OnTrac, and the actual base offered may vary depending on several factors including, but not limited to: geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, job-related skills and competencies, market alignment, and financial considerations.
  • Compensation decisions are made based on the specific circumstances of each hire to ensure fair and competitive pay.
  • This job posting is anticipated to remain open for at least 30 days from the date of posting.

data.title: Platform Engineer - Compute Capacity
data.description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We are seeking a platform engineer to join our Compute Capacity team. This team owns the capacity plan that keeps compute supply ahead of demand across every region we operate in — the forecasting, buffer policy, and provisioning systems that make sure a project never runs into a wall it didn't know was there.

You'll work on the systems that turn a capacity plan into provisioned reality: reservation acquisition, fleet reconciliation, and the automation that keeps what we've committed to in sync with what we're actually running. You'll help build the metrics and alerting that let capacity problems surface months out, on vendor lead time, rather than at the moment someone needs the room.

You'll design, build, and operate systems that are both robust and highly automated — helping us hold the right buffer at the right cost, catch drift before it becomes a shortage, and give every team a single, trustworthy view of how much room we have across the millions of databases we manage.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Help build and maintain the capacity plan that keeps Supabase's compute supply ahead of demand across regions and instance families

  • Support buffer policy by modeling headroom targets and their cost tradeoffs for review and sign-off

  • Build and maintain automation that turns the capacity plan into provisioned reality — reservation acquisition and top-up, fleet reconciliation, drift detection between committed and running capacity

  • Extend our infrastructure as code for capacity-relevant provisioning

  • Instrument capacity: build and maintain metrics for saturation, reservation coverage, idle buffer, forecast error, and provisioning latency

  • Build and tune capacity alerting so headroom, quota, and reservation issues surface months out rather than at the moment of impact

  • Support the demand gate — helping intake large customer commitments, launches, migrations, and new regions so they reach the plan before they reach the fleet

  • Contribute to mitigation projects: right-sizing, instance-family migrations, autoscaling improvements, workload consolidation

  • Help drive down compute cost per database through right-sizing, placement, and commitment coverage work

  • Participate in capacity incident response and post-incident follow-through

You Might Be A Good Fit If You

  • Have 5+ years across infrastructure engineering, SRE, platform, or capacity engineering, ideally at SaaS or cloud infrastructure scale

  • Have production software engineering experience — you've owned and operated a service, not just a notebook. Comfortable in modern languages like TypeScript, Python, and Go

  • Are comfortable working against forecasts and assumptions that are incomplete, and can revise your work as those assumptions change

  • Have experience with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi or Terraform)

  • Have built or maintained observability for systems you own — metrics that answer real questions and alerting people trust (Prometheus/Grafana, CloudWatch, or similar);

  • Have solid working knowledge of AWS EC2: instance families and generations, purchase options, capacity reservations, and quota mechanics

  • Have some financial fluency — you understand reservation economics and the basic tradeoffs between coverage, utilization, and cost

  • Communicate clearly across audiences, from engineers to finance stakeholders

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team
